info.name: Apex Bank — V1 API Collection
info.description:
Authoritative Postman API testing collection for Apex Bank (V1 HTTP API Contract).

### Contract Baseline
- **Total Documented V1 Endpoints in `docs/api.md`:** 215 distinct HTTP method/path combinations.
- **API Prefix:** `/api/v1` (`{{baseUrl}}` = `http://localhost:8080/api/v1`).
- **Authentication:** Short-lived (5-minute) Bearer JWT access token in `Authorization` header (`{{customerAccessToken}}`, `{{managerAccessToken}}`, `{{adminAccessToken}}`). Session renewal uses a 2-hour `HttpOnly` cookie on `Path=/api/v1/auth`.
- **Standard Error Envelope:** `{ "code", "message", "details", "fieldErrors", "traceId" }`.
- **Note on Implementation State:** Only Foundation Milestones 1–6 are currently implemented. Business domain requests are marked `[CONTRACT - UNIMPLEMENTED]` and will be activated and expanded incrementally as each backend module is implemented.
